name: Sanderson Farms
old_description: Our portfolio of brands help nourish people around the world.
about:
Wayne-Sanderson Farms, headquartered in Collins, Mississippi, was formed from the combination of two longstanding poultry companies with humble roots. The business draws on over a century of industry experience, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. Ownership details are not publicly specified in the source material.

The company operates as the nation’s third-largest poultry producer, employing more than 26,000 team members and partnering with over 2,000 family farmers. Its operations span poultry production, processing, and brand management, delivering a portfolio of high-quality, affordable chicken products to customers and consumers worldwide. The company emphasizes efficient operations, resource conservation, renewable energy, and waste reduction as part of its sustainable impact commitments.

Wayne-Sanderson Farms serves the food and beverage, agriculture, retail, and food-service sectors. Concrete customer-facing examples include its designation as the “Official Chicken of the Southeastern Conference” and a partnership with LPGA professional Jenny Bae, whose family has raised chickens for the company for a decade. The firm also engages in community initiatives, such as the Sanderson Farms Championship, which generated $1.75 million for Mississippi charities in 2024, and a rescue truck donation that enhanced local emergency response.

The company states its vision is to be “amazing by being the partner of choice,” differentiating itself through scale, a network of family farmers, sustainability commitments, and community investment.
